name: ZainaPlatform Dev
onCreateCommand: curl -fsSL https://packages.redis.io/gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/redis-archive-keyring.gpg && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/redis-archive-keyring.gpg] https://packages.redis.io/deb bookworm main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/redis.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y redis-server postgresql postgresql-client && sudo service postgresql start && sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER vscode WITH SUPERUSER PASSWORD 'zainarocks';" && sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE zainaplatform OWNER vscode;"
postCreateCommand: dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef && echo 'export PATH=$PATH:$HOME/.dotnet/tools' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'ZainaPlatform dev environment ready ✓'
